topology.SW1: Vlan10 management 192.168.10.1/24; Gi0/24 trunk to SW2; Gi0/2 access to PC1
topology.SW2: Vlan10 management 192.168.10.2/24; Gi0/24 trunk to SW1; Gi0/2 access to PC2
topology.Discovery: Network-facing ports use CDP and bidirectional LLDP; both protocols suppressed on PC-facing Gi0/2 ports; 5-second advertisements and 15-second holdtimes for the exercise

checks: Independent portable practice attempts begin with zero credit, ready VLAN/IP data paths, and explicitly disabled global and network-facing discovery; the fixture does not misrepresent factory defaults
Published IOS commands enable and save global CDP/LLDP, timers, network-facing controls and PC-facing suppression on all three network nodes
Six configuration/live-neighbor tasks pass before observed traffic; both actual PC directions receive replies and complete the eight-task guide
Delivered physical advertisements are required for neighbor credit; accepted configuration alone and synthetic display rows cannot satisfy the received-neighbor criteria
Each protocol has four correct local/remote port relationships: SW1 learns R1 and SW2, while R1 and SW2 learn only SW1; ordinary PCs do not advertise or appear as invented neighbors
LLDP transmit suppression ages only the remote observer after the last advertised 15-second holdtime, while local receive, CDP and real PC traffic remain available; restoration relearns the partner
LLDP receive suppression removes the local view while remote reception continues; no cdp enable disables both CDP directions on that port; repair restores received state
Protocol-specific lost advertisements retain the last received hostname, description and management address until expiry; fresh advertisements replace the snapshot with updated TLVs
Discovery stays local to physical links and works without IP addresses; existing management SVIs are advertised when present, and discovery is independent of normal data forwarding
Endpoint suppression requires CDP disabled, LLDP transmit disabled and LLDP receive disabled on a working data port; shutting down a PC port cannot substitute for suppression

Every published show/ping command works, including global status/timers, interface controls, traffic counters, summary and detailed neighbors with learned capabilities, management addresses and port IDs
Portable saves, renamed devices and startup power cycles preserve configuration and earned echo observations, but live neighbor goals require fresh advertisements after reload

Imported discovery criteria accept bounded protocol/timer/port data and IOS defaults; reject wrong peers, wrong interfaces, expired evidence, malformed protocols, unsupported ranges and nonboolean controls
scope: Uses existing CDP, LLDP, STP and Ethernet/IPv4 packet simulation. Adds the catalog lab and declarative guide criteria; no simulation engine changes, new networking commands or server dependency. Aging is a guided exercise using existing CLI and traffic controls; restore both LLDP directions for full live credit. No CML validation is claimed for this catalog addition.
